items.title: I wrapped the Zorks with an LLM
items.raw_excerpt: I grew up on the Infocom games and when microsoft actually open-sourced Zork 1/2/3 I really wanted to figure out how to use LLMs to let you type whatever you want, I always found the amount language that the games "understood" to be so limiting - even if it was pretty state of the art at the time. So I figured out how to wrap it with Tambo.. (and run the game engine in the browser) basically whatever you type gets "translated" into zork-speak and passed to the game - and then the LLM takes the game's output and optionally adds flavor. (the little ">_" button at the top exposes the actual game input) What was a big surprise to me is multi-turn instructions - you can ask it to "Explore all the rooms in the house until you can't find any more" and it will plug away at the game for 10+ "turns"

title_i18n.en: I wrapped the Zorks with an LLM
title_i18n.zh: 我用LLM包装了Zorks。
title_i18n.es: Envolví a los Zorks con un modelo de lenguaje grande.

So I figured out how to wrap it with Tambo.. (and run the game engine in the browser) basically whatever you type gets "translated" into zork-speak and passed to the game - and then the LLM takes the game's output and optionally adds flavor. (the little ">_" button at the top exposes the actual game input) What was a big surprise to me is multi-turn instructions - you can ask it to "Explore all the rooms in the house until you can't find any more" and it will plug away at the game for 10+ "turns"
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我从小玩Infocom游戏长大，当微软开源Zork 1/2/3时，我特别想研究如何用大语言模型实现自由输入——我一直觉得游戏能“理解”的语言范围太有限了。
excerpt_i18n.es: Crecí con los juegos de Infocom y cuando Microsoft liberó el código de Zork 1/2/3, realmente quería descubrir cómo usar modelos de lenguaje grandes para permitirte escribir lo que quieras; siempre me sorprendió la cantidad de lenguaje que los juegos "entendían".

excerpt_i18n.en:
In 2025, China's smart glasses market is experiencing pre-breakout turbulence. Data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shows that shipments in the first three quarters exceeded 1.78 million units, representing a several-fold increase compared to 2024. The annual sales of 2 million units for Meta Ray-Ban's camera glasses validate the market's potential. Companies like Xiaomi and Li Auto are entering the fray, yet the industry is mired in a collective dilemma: consumers are forced to choose among audio, camera, and display glasses as single-option devices, with newly purchased gadgets quickly becoming obsolete due to rapid technological iteration. Manufacturers are obsessed with a lightweight race but are trapped in the impossible triangle of "lightweight, high performance, and long battery life."

Just as the entire industry is caught in a cycle of "innovation for innovation's sake," Xuanjing unveiled a potential breakthrough at its Tech Open Day. Its M6 series breaks the boundaries of product form with a "magnetic modular" design, redefines user experience logic through "active AI interaction," and challenges the industry's decade-old iron law of iteration with the philosophy of "buy once, upgrade forever."

Modularity Rewrites Iteration Rules
"What users want is not three functionally fragmented glasses, but a solution that can be combined and upgraded freely as needed," said Xie Xin, Vice President of Xuanjing, capturing the original intent of modular design. In April 2025, Xuanjing launched the ultra-lightweight M5 clip-on AR glasses weighing 25.8 grams. Its "zero-barrier" design, compatible with prescription glasses, topped three major JD.com charts within four hours of launch, reinforcing the team's commitment to modularity.
excerpt_i18n.es: En 2025, el mercado chino de gafas inteligentes experimenta una agitación previa a su explosión: datos del Ministerio de Industria y Tecnología de la Información muestran que en los primeros tres trimestres las ventas superaron los 1,78 millones de unidades, multiplicándose varias veces en comparación con 2024. Las gafas con cámara Meta Ray-Ban, con ventas anuales de 2 millones de unidades, confirman el potencial del mercado. Fabricantes como Xiaomi y Li Auto se han sumado al sector, pero la industria se enfrenta a un dilema colectivo: los consumidores se ven obligados a elegir entre gafas de audio, de cámara o con pantalla, y los dispositivos recién adquiridos pronto quedan obsoletos por la rápida evolución tecnológica, convirtiéndose en "chatarra electrónica". Los fabricantes, obsesionados con la competencia por la ligereza, caen en el trilema imposible de "ligereza, alto rendimiento y larga duración de la batería". Mientras toda la industria se debate en la "innovación por innovar".

items.title: 上交大 SciMaster 团队新作：一个「AI 物理博士」的诞生
items.raw_excerpt: 当大模型的能力从能回答问题走向能完成任务，AI for Science 也正在经历一次更深层的转向。 过去行业更关注模型在标准题目、知识问答和文献总结上的表现，但这些能力本质上仍属于信息处理，它们可以提升效率，却很难真正改变科研本身的推进方式。 现实科研的核心难点并不在于单点能力是否强，而在于研究过程天然是长链条、不确定、强依赖验证的闭环系统。一个看似简单的物理问题，往往需要经历建模选择、推导路径、数值实验设计、代码实现、调参排错、对照基准结果、误差来源分析等一整套流程，任何一步出错都可能导致结论失效。 也正因为如此，科研效率的瓶颈长期不在想法是否聪明，而在能否把想法变成可信结果，大量时间消耗在重复工程与试错迭代中。 在这样的行业背景下，上海交通大学 SciMaster 团队联合深势科技、中科院理论物理所在研究论文《PHYSMASTER: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research》中给出了一个更激进的答案，与其把 AI 当作分散的辅助工具，不如直接构建一个能够组织、规划并执行科研闭环的自主系统。 研究团队用五个真实的物理科研任务验证其能力，从加速成熟工作流，到自动完成复杂数值研究，再到尝试自主探索开放问题，展示了 AI 迈向可持续推进科研的可能路径。 这项研究真正值得关注的地方，不只是模型算得更快或写得更像人，而是它让我们看到一种潜在的新科研范式，AI 不再只是科研流程中的局部工具，而可能成为能够承担完整研究链条的研究主体之一。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.19799 五项任务跑通科研闭环 这项工作并不是在一个统一的数据集上跑模型分数，而是通过五个真实的物理科研任务来验证系统能力，并将这些任务按能力层级分为三

excerpt_i18n.zh: 当大模型的能力从能回答问题走向能完成任务，AI for Science 也正在经历一次更深层的转向。 过去行业更关注模型在标准题目、知识问答和文献总结上的表现，但这些能力本质上仍属于信息处理，它们可以提升效率，却很难真正改变科研本身的推进方式。 现实科研的核心难点并不在于单点能力是否强，而在于研究过程天然是长链条、不确定、强依赖验证的闭环系统。一个看似简单的物理问题，往往需要经历建模选择、推导路径、数值实验设计、代码实现、调参排错、对照基准结果、误差来源分析等一整套流程，任何一步出错都可能导致结论失效。 也正因为如此，科研效率的瓶颈长期不在想法是否聪明，而在能否把想法变成可信结果，大量时间消耗在重复工程与试错迭代中。 在这样的行业背景下，上海交通大学 SciMaster 团队联合深势科技、中科院理论物理所在研究论文《PHYSMASTER: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research》中给出了一个更激进的答案，与其把 AI 当作分散的辅助工具，不如直接构建一个能够组织、规划并执行科研闭环的自主系统。 研究团队用五个真实的物理科研任务验证其能力，从加速成熟工作流，到自动完成复杂数值研究，再到尝试自主探索开放问题，展示了 AI 迈向可持续推进科研的可能路径。 这项研究真正值得关注的地方，不只是模型算得更快或写得更像人，而是它让我们看到一种潜在的新科研范式，AI 不再只是科研流程中的局部工具，而可能成为能够承担完整研究链条的研究主体之一。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.19799 五项任务跑通科研闭环 这项工作并不是在一个统一的数据集上跑模型分数，而是通过五个真实的物理科研任务来验证系统能力，并将这些任务按能力层级分为三
excerpt_i18n.en: As large models evolve from answering questions to completing tasks, AI for Science is undergoing a deeper transformation. Previously, the industry focused more on model performance in standardized tasks, knowledge Q&A, and literature summarization, but these capabilities essentially remain information processing—they can enhance efficiency but hardly change the fundamental way research progresses. The core challenge in real-world research lies not in the strength of isolated capabilities, but in the inherently long-chain, uncertain, and validation-dependent closed-loop nature of the research process. A seemingly simple physics problem often requires a full workflow: model selection, derivation paths, numerical experiment design, code implementation, parameter tuning and debugging, benchmarking against reference results, and error source analysis. Any misstep can invalidate the conclusions. Consequently, the bottleneck in research efficiency has long been not the cleverness of ideas, but the ability to turn ideas into credible results, with significant time spent on repetitive engineering and trial-and-error iterations. excerpt_i18n.es: Cuando las capacidades de los grandes modelos evolucionan de responder preguntas a completar tareas, la IA para la Ciencia también está experimentando una transformación más profunda. Anteriormente, la industria se centraba más en el rendimiento de los modelos en preguntas estándar, respuestas de conocimiento y resúmenes de literatura, pero estas habilidades pertenecen esencialmente al procesamiento de información; pueden mejorar la eficiencia, pero difícilmente cambian verdaderamente la forma en que avanza la investigación científica. La dificultad central de la investigación real no radica en si una habilidad puntual es fuerte, sino en que el proceso de investigación es inherentemente un sistema cerrado de cadena larga, incierto y altamente dependiente de la verificación. Un problema físico aparentemente simple a menudo requiere pasar por la selección de modelos, la ruta de derivación, el diseño de experimentos numéricos, la implementación de código, el ajuste de parámetros y la depuración de errores, y la comparación.

items.title: 清华教授翟季冬：Benchmark正在「失效」，智能路由终结大模型选型乱象
items.raw_excerpt: 作者 | 赵之齐 编辑 | 包永刚 北京一月的初雪落下前，我们在清华见到了翟季冬教授。他手持保温杯，说话很利落，即便一边思考一边叙述，言辞间也几乎没有停顿、没有模糊地带。 这位曾带队拿下15次世界超算冠军的清华计算机系长聘教授，此刻正在拆解一个行业怪象： 为什么在大模型参数狂飙、算力价格下探的当下，用户的AI落地负担却越来越重？ 他指出，如今Benchmark（基准测试）上的高分，在比对用户真实需求时不一定管用，有时，同个模型在不同MaaS平台上跑出来的效果可能差异巨大，因为部分服务商为了降低成本，会对模型进行“阉割级”量化。而面对眼花缭乱的MaaS供应商，用户要在性能、价格与稳定性之间做取舍，往往光调研一轮市场报价，就已耗尽精力。 “把选型的主动权完全交给用户，其实是很大的挑战” ， 翟季冬直言。这种“选择悖论”不仅折磨着开发者，更在吞噬企业的利润——对于企业来说， 降本增效的核心可能并非追求最顶尖的模型，而是如何调度能力恰当的模型，让昂贵的大模型处理复杂指令，让轻量的小模型应付日常任务。 洞察到这一痛点后，由翟季冬的几位毕业学生发起的AI Infra厂商——清程极智，开发出智能路由产品AI Ping（AI 评），希望成为算力界的“大众点评”。 他们将分散的性能数据系统性整理，并收集用户的使用习惯，公开不同模型与供应商的测评数据，并给用户推荐合适的、高性价比方案。翟季冬认为，这种产品形态， 有助于撬动算力行业的马太效应——他相信，当数据越集中，模型的选择就越精准；选择越精准，用户需要付出的成本就越低。 翟季冬 与我们交流时，尽管判断明确，翟季冬说话时的语气却始终都是温和的。他走进会议室时，手上拎着提前为我们备好的饮用水；对话结束后，还为北京凛冽的寒潮给我们来访带来的困扰而“致歉”。待人的认真，也换来了学生们的真心相待——在许多博士生习惯将导师称为“老板”的当下，他的博士生

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author | Zhao Zhiqi  Editor | Bao Yonggang  
Before the first snow of January fell in Beijing, we met Professor Zhai Jidong at Tsinghua University. Holding a thermal cup, he spoke briskly, with almost no pauses or ambiguities even while thinking and narrating simultaneously.  
This tenured professor from Tsinghua’s Department of Computer Science, who has led his team to win 15 world supercomputing championships, was dissecting an industry anomaly:  
Why, amid the soaring parameters of large models and the declining cost of computing power, are users’ burdens for AI implementation becoming increasingly heavy?  
He pointed out that high scores on benchmarks may not always align with users’ actual needs. Sometimes, the same model can perform vastly differently across various MaaS platforms, as some providers apply “castration-level” quantization to reduce costs. Faced with a dizzying array of MaaS suppliers, users must weigh performance, price, and stability, often exhausting their energy just by surveying market quotes.  
“Leaving the initiative of model selection entirely to users is actually a significant challenge,” Zhai Jidong stated frankly. This “paradox of choice” not only torments developers but also erodes corporate profits. For enterprises, the core of cost reduction and efficiency improvement may not lie in pursuing the most cutting-edge models, but in how to deploy appropriately capable models—using expensive large models for complex instructions and lightweight small models for routine tasks.  
Recognizing this pain point, Qingcheng Jizhi, an AI infrastructure company founded by several of Zhai Jidong’s former students, developed an intelligent routing system.
